text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My classmate Chiyono O has a "dream": to 
catch up to Maruzen-senpai, whom she 
admires so much, and compete with 
everything she's got!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We both share having an opponent we want 
to challenge someday! We cheered on each 
other's passionate "dreams" and talked 
about giving it our all!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Both Yaeno and Chiyono O shine so brightly 
whenever they talk about their "dreams"! I 
can't afford to lose to them either, no 
way~!!
